propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate has been the Senior Revenue Operations Analyst at a software company for three years, responsible for the board revenue pack and signing it off before the finance director's review, after three years as a revenue operations analyst assembling the pack, six years in revenue operations in all.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the signed-off pack document the senior role and the six years.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate supervised the analyst who assembled the pack through the assembly checklist and the variance commentary review, and reconciled the pack to the billing system monthly under the team's reconciliation procedure.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the workbook document the supervision and the reconciliation.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate wrote the pack boundary note and the open items list that went to the finance director with each monthly pack, and holds a BSc in Economics.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the work sample document the boundary note and the degree.

expectedGap: None; the materials document the senior analyst role, the years, the supervision, the reconciliation and the boundary notes.
expectedBoundaryNote: The senior analyst role and the six years are documented in the resume and the signed-off pack; the analyst years are shown separately from the senior years.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask for the finance director's review record naming the candidate as the signing analyst.
